name: Sun Medical Equipment Company, Inc.
old_description: Sun Medical Equipment & Supplies is a locally owned and operated company focused on serving the home health needs of patients in Oakland, Macomb, and Wayne Counties. Since 1979, we have been providing home medical equipment and home care services that allow our customers to get access to the items and care they need where they’re most comfortable — at home! We can work with your healthcare provider to make sure you receive the right equipment. We’re looking forward to working with you to meet your needs as a patient.
about:
Sun Medical Equipment & Supplies was founded in 1979 in Troy, Michigan, as a locally owned and operated business serving the home health needs of patients across Oakland, Macomb, and Wayne Counties. The company began with a focus on providing durable medical equipment and in-home care services that allow customers to remain comfortable at home.

The company operates a retail store in Troy and an online catalog, supplying home medical equipment from brands such as Philips, LIFEPAK, and AirMini. Its product range includes CPAP machines, AEDs, cold therapy systems, mobility aids, hospital beds, oxygen and respiratory equipment, bath safety items, compression garments, orthotic braces, wound care supplies, and power scooters. Sun Medical also provides in-home care staffed by nurses, home health aides, and caregivers, overseen by a registered nurse. The staff offers expertise in mobility equipment fitting, orthotic and compression garment fitting, Medicare billing, and home modification installation.

Sun Medical serves individual patients, union members (who receive exclusive discounts), and healthcare providers such as Corewell Health. The company works with professional organizations including the National Homecare & Hospice Association, the Michigan Homecare & Hospice Association, the Michigan Spinal Cord Injury Association, and the Case Management Society of America.

The company emphasizes its accreditation by the Community Health Accreditation Partner, Inc., and its commitment to staying at the forefront of industry changes to deliver quality service. It highlights 5-star customer ratings and a mission to provide everything from A to Z for comfort, independence, safety, and security at home.
